azure-firewall-delete-unused.body: This non-production estimate runs a firewall all month. Azure Firewall bills a fixed hourly charge per deployment while it exists, so Microsoft recommends stopping deployments that do not need to run continuously; if the environment is only needed part of the time, lower the hours.
azure-firewall-delete-unused.title: Stop test firewalls when you are not using them

citation.source: Architecture best practices for Azure Firewall (Cost Optimization)
citation.quote: Stop Azure Firewall deployments that don't need to continuously run.

azure-firewall-share-instance.body: This estimate has several firewalls, each billing a fixed hourly charge. If some are in the same region, Microsoft recommends sharing one Azure Firewall across spoke networks that connect to the same hub; firewalls in different regions are still needed separately.
azure-firewall-share-instance.title: Share one firewall across networks

citation.source: Architecture best practices for Azure Firewall (Cost Optimization)
citation.quote: Share the same instance of Azure Firewall.

azure-firewall-premium-nonprod.body: Premium costs more per deployment hour than Standard (data processing is the same price per GB). Microsoft positions Premium for highly sensitive workloads such as payment processing, so a non-production estimate may be fine on Standard.
azure-firewall-premium-nonprod.title: Is Premium needed for non-production?

citation.source: Architecture best practices for Azure Firewall (Cost Optimization)
citation.quote: Use Azure Firewall Premium to secure highly sensitive applications, such as payment processing.
